label: owns or is parent of
definition: Person or organization X owns business, asset or organization Y, or is Y’s organizational parent.
scope_notes: This is the direction-reversed ownership family, distinct from subsidiary-of. Direct owns, owner or parent evidence qualifies. A mere partial stake or proposed acquisition is not silently treated as full ownership; direct ownership elsewhere can support the fact. Historical ownership qualifies.
